title: Trend Radar
subtitle: What is trending and making news in your market, ready to become content
intro: This page gathers, around the clock, what is trending and making news in Ezra Plastering's world. Each card comes with an angle ready to turn into a Reel. Approve the ones you want to produce, dismiss the ones that do not fit, and leave a comment anytime. It updates on its own.

voice.quem: Ezra Plastering, an owner-run plastering specialist in Greater Boston that turns walls and ceilings into premium, handcrafted finishes (Venetian, Tadelakt, Microcement) and restores damaged plaster for high-end homes.
voice.eixo_viral: jaw-dropping before-and-after transformations plus insider craft knowledge that makes affluent homeowners trust the artisan on site, not the cheapest bid.
voice.tom: confident craft authority that impresses: technical enough to prove mastery, warm enough to earn trust, always showing the transformation and the care behind it. Never salesy, never cheap.
voice.gancho_formula: specific pain or wow + concrete promise/result + curiosity gap that makes them watch to the end.
voice.gancho_default: THIS WALL WAS PLAIN DRYWALL 48 HOURS AGO
voice.alvo_default: affluent Greater Boston homeowners renovating a high-end space

alvo.homeowner: affluent homeowner in Greater Boston renovating a kitchen, bathroom or feature wall
alvo.designer: interior designer or architect looking for a reliable premium plaster specialist
alvo.restoration: owner of an older or historic New England home with cracked or water-damaged plaster

voice.angulo_corpo: open with the wow or the pain, show the real finish or repair up close, explain in plain words why it lasts and why it looks that good, and prove the owner is on the job from start to clean finish.
voice.angulo_corpo_video: hook on the transformation in the first 2 seconds (before shot), fast satisfying process clips of the trowel and finish, one myth-busting or insider tip, close on the finished room and who it was for.
voice.angulo_fecho: invite them to picture that finish in their own home and reach out for a walkthrough, always leading with the value and the result, never with the price.
